task.title: Edit tasks
task.body:
Keep the board true from the phone. See [[Experience#tasks]].

- [ ] Task engine writes: change a field keeping order, comments, line endings; conformance cases for each kind
- [ ] Status, type, priority, assignee (people picker), epic (moves the file), labels in bottom sheets; custom fields
- [ ] Tick checklist items in the description
- [ ] Drag cards between columns and swimlanes; **Move to…** on long press
- [ ] Edit title and description
- [ ] New task with the next ID, from the board, a column, the app icon's quick action and shared text; type templates
